newsitem.title: USA: Riverside Hospital, Del., settles Medicare case.
newsitem.headline: Riverside Hospital, Del., settles Medicare case.

text.p: Riverside Hospital in Wilmington and the U.S. Attorney's Office have agreed on a settlement after allegations the hospital submitted false claims to Medicare.
The hospital will pay more than $470,000 in reimbursements for allegedly over-billing patients and misleading Medicare about services provided. Riverside Hospital denied the charges.
According to U.S. Attorney Gregory Sleet, the hospital stopped providing services under Medicare or Medicaid as of last October.
